start.prompt:
Create a NEW CRESUM exercise illustration: Cable Straight-Arm Pulldown, START. One complete white-studio frame, landscape 1536 x 1024.

REFERENCE ROLES:
1. ORIGINAL five-view Male Master: exact adult man's identity, face/hair, natural athletic proportions, fitted blue-gray T-shirt, dark-gray shorts, white socks, light-gray shoes. Render ONE man.
2. Frozen CRESUM equipment style: satin light silver-gray structure, graphite shrouds and black matte hardware, clean joins, neutral soft lighting, gentle contact shadows and refined realistic 3D materials ONLY. Do not copy this reference's assisted-pullup apparatus or pose.
3. Official Axiom OP-DAP side photograph: real apparatus geometry and physical pulley system. Show the complete dual adjustable pulley station, both columns, fixed upper bridge/braces, protected stacks, supported high carriage and base feet. Recolor only structural metal to the approved light silver finish. No logos or stickers.
4. User's TWO-PHASE diagram: movement/pose reference ONLY. For THIS frame use the LEFT-panel START. The RIGHT-panel finish is for the later matching frame. Do not copy its gray anatomical person, muscle highlights, red text, labels, simplified machine or two-panel layout.

NEW COMPOSITION:
Follow the diagram's overall direction: athlete primarily on the LEFT facing the cable station on the RIGHT. Use a clear side/front-three-quarter camera, mild perspective, so both closed hand grips, the middle of the short straight bar, cable terminal and the supported high pulley are legible. Entire apparatus and entire athlete visible with comfortable white margins. The athlete stands on open floor outside the station and clear of its bases. Physically correct man-to-machine scale: this is the same roughly 178-cm Master man in a hinge, not a larger or smaller person.
Keep this camera and all floor/foot/machine positions suitable for an exactly matching FINISH.

START POSE, from the diagram:
A stable moderate HIP HINGE (roughly 30–40 degrees forward from vertical), hips back, knees softly bent, both feet grounded about hip-width apart. Neutral long spine and head aligned with the torso; no rounded back, arch or squat. Keep the trunk and lower-body angles fixed for the future FINISH.
Both arms reach FORWARD AND UP toward the high pulley, as in the diagram's LEFT panel. Long nearly straight arms with only a small soft elbow bend. Hands around head height/upward in front of the inclined torso. This is standing straight-arm shoulder-extension pulldown, not a row or triceps pushdown.

ATTACHMENT:
A SHORT STRAIGHT BLACK BAR with matching small rounded cylindrical black end caps. Symmetric approximately shoulder-width closed pronated hand grips, thumbs wrapped and wrists neutral. The cable-attachment eye is at the actual bar midpoint, visibly BETWEEN the two hand grips. Each hand must be on a different side of the eye. Both end caps have only a short modest extension beyond the hands. Do not invent a long free bar extension or hide an end inside the person.
ONE taut cable leaves the real groove of a genuinely supported HIGH pulley and runs through air to ONE small central carabiner/eye on that bar. The active carriage is locked high. No second working cable or extra lower handle on the active column. The other station output remains normally parked.

STYLE:
Photorealistic premium 3D, actual Master character and calm consistent skin/fabric. Full body and full machine, white studio, satin silver/graphite equipment, matte surfaces, neutral soft light and contact shadows. No text, phase labels, muscle colors, diagrams, inset views or arrows. Output ONE START frame only.

initialStartBase.prompt:
Create ONE polished photorealistic 3D exercise illustration for the CRESUM fitness app, landscape 1536 x 1024, white studio background. Exercise: standing Cable Straight-Arm Pulldown, START phase only.

REFERENCE ROLES, in supplied order:
1. The ORIGINAL five-view Male Master sheet: exact character identity and outfit reference. Render only ONE instance of that adult man: short styled brown hair, clean-shaven face, athletic natural proportions, fitted blue-gray T-shirt, dark-gray shorts, white ankle socks, light-gray trainers. Preserve this person's face, build, skin texture, clothing cut, and colors.
2. Official Life Fitness Axiom OP-DAP platinum FRONT product photograph: actual cable-station geometry and proportions.
3. Official Life Fitness Axiom OP-DAP platinum SIDE product photograph: same machine's depth, protected cable routing, carriage construction, feet, and fixed braces.
4. Approved CRESUM equipment-style reference: materials, rendering quality, restrained silver finish and graphite details ONLY. Do not copy its assisted-pullup apparatus, kneeling pose, knee pad, steps, or any other geometry.

SCENE AND CAMERA:
Use the real dual adjustable cable station from references 2 and 3. Its satin light silver-gray uprights and structural members, two dark graphite weight-stack shrouds, realistic fixed upper bridge and diagonal upper braces, base rails, and dark rubber feet must form one coherent grounded object. Keep the actual OP-DAP construction rather than inventing a standalone modular pulley tower. Remove all brand logos, text, numbered scales, stickers, and decorative attachments. Keep any adjustment knob small and unobtrusive. The unused second cable system remains mechanically normal and parked, without a second cable leading to the active bar.
Compose the whole machine primarily at the left, with the athlete standing in unobstructed open floor to the right, facing the working high pulley. Use a clear natural side-three-quarter camera at approximately the athlete's lower-chest height so both arms, hands, attachment, and active cable are readable, while the whole station and both feet remain visible. The man is standing OUTSIDE the machine, clear of its frame and base rails. Keep correct adult-to-machine scale (roughly 178 cm man, 220 cm station). Full machine, bar, man and shoes must fit with comfortable margins, no cropped apparatus or body parts. Unified perspective and consistent scale for a future matching FINISH image. A coherent centered composition that will also look balanced inside a square contain-fit card.

START POSE:
Feet about hip-width apart, both soles on the floor, soft knees, stable pelvis and braced neutral torso. At most a very slight natural forward inclination; no deep hip hinge, back arch, twisting or momentum. Head follows the torso with a neutral neck. The man reaches both arms forward and upward, with the hands above shoulder height, approximately eye-to-forehead height. Both elbows have only a SMALL soft bend (about 10–15 degrees); clearly show long nearly straight arms, not elbows bent to a right angle. Shoulders are flexed comfortably, arms roughly 25–35 degrees above horizontal. He holds a short straight cable bar with symmetric closed pronated grips a little wider than shoulder-width, thumbs wrapped around it, anatomically plausible fingers and neutral wrists. The bar stays straight and perpendicular to the direction of the pull. This is a standing straight-arm shoulder-extension pulldown, not a triceps pushdown or seated lat pulldown.

CRITICAL MECHANICS:
The active adjustable pulley carriage on the working column is locked at a genuinely HIGH position above the man's hands. Show an intact actual swivel pulley housing, supported and attached to its guide column. Exactly ONE taut working cable leaves the real pulley groove tangentially, travels clearly through empty air diagonally down toward the athlete, and ends at a single centered metal eye/carabiner on the straight bar. A plausible cable stop and connector belong to this same line. No floating attachment, no cable ending on a hand, no off-center bar fastening, no cable cutting through a person or frame, no extra diagonal cable from a random brace. Leave enough standing distance for the same long arms to sweep the bar down toward the thighs in FINISH without hitting the machine. The actual machine support frame, stack shrouds, and guide columns remain fixed. Do not add a seat, thigh roller, chest pad, knee pad, plate-loaded lever or free weight plates.

RENDER:
Match the approved CRESUM series: high-quality realistic 3D product visualization, even clean skin with fine natural texture, matte fabric, satin light metal, dark graphite polymer and rubber, soft neutral studio light, gentle contact shadows, white seamless floor/background, restrained reflections, crisp believable engineering and human anatomy. No dramatic shadows, excessive gloss, orange cast, text, START labels, arrows, inset views, watermarks, transparent background, muscle highlighting, or duplicate people. Output the ONE START illustration only.
